plain: Training a model on the attacks that break it, so it learns to refuse them.
eli5: Practising against the tricks your little brother uses, so next time they stop working on you.
technical: Fine-tuning on attack inputs generated during training (for HarmBench's R2D2, a refreshed pool of GCG test cases with a loss toward refusal and away from the target string), which tends to buy robustness to the attack family trained against more than to others.
